name: smwpatches-different-submap-switching-transition-v1
title: Different Submap Switching Transition v1.1
description:
This simple patch changes the submap switching (aka "red path") transition on the overworld, removing the window closing/opening and changing it to a brightness fadeout/fadein. Besides having a different graphical effect, this also solves the issue of HDMA effects turning off or looking weird during the original transition (note: if you're using different gradients for each submap, you'll need to put the HDMA code in both init and main to make it load properly after the red path transition).

v1.1: fixes an issue with AddmusicK, where the screen doesn't fully go black before loading the submap music
